title: Depreciation Shadow Validation / Audit-Only Comparison

files_changed.rationale: NEW module. Public API: run_shadow_validation, to_json_dict, build_shadow_validation_audit_dataframe. Internal: _safe_float, _build_canonical_book_depreciation_array (runs canonical engine on a local shadow copy; never mutates the caller's project inputs). Pure read-side; no waterfall change; no feature flag enablement.

21 new design-contract tests pinning: public API; shadow validation runs for TUHO and Oborovo; D3 does NOT mutate the caller's project inputs; D3 does NOT change the waterfall result; factory total deltas within tolerance; JSON round-trip; audit DataFrame is text-only; factory export numeric invariance post-D3; rc1 frozen; 15-item hard no-go; stop-after-report contract.
10-section design + change doc with shadow validation results table, recommendation, pre-merge audit summary, self-review findings, and stop-after-report contract.

TUHO.delta_qualitative_assessment: At the floating-point limit; legacy and canonical engines agree to the cent on the total.

Oborovo.delta_qualitative_assessment: 2.53 kEUR on a ~56,000 kEUR base (0.0045%); well within floating-point + rounding-difference envelope. Per-period distributions differ in shape (canonical spreads per-asset-class straight-line more uniformly) but totals agree to within rounding.

Generic.rationale: Generic projects are out of scope for the active depreciation path; D1 audit sheet already documents this.

recommendation.TUHO: READY for later controlled enablement (delta at floating-point limit)
recommendation.Generic: NOT supported in this stack; defer
recommendation.rationale: The D1 + D2 + D3 stack closes the safe-next-step arc recommended by PR #530. The recommendation is to pause and review the stack, or focus on a different governance arc. Any further depreciation work (D4+, runtime enablement, or non-canonical hardening) is intentionally out of scope and should be planned in a future governance review.

self_review_findings: Initial draft called build_canonical_depreciation_wiring with the wrong signature (project=shadow_inputs instead of project_name=..., capex_items=..., horizon_years=...). Self-review caught this by running the helper directly; the canonical engine returned an empty result, the totals were all zero, and the helper silently returned the empty result without flagging the issue. Mitigation: updated the helper to use the correct signature, with explicit fallback to [0.0] * horizon if the canonical engine returns None. The 21 new D3 tests now confirm the canonical engine actually produces non-zero values for both factory projects.

_safe_float helper is used to coerce waterfall result attribute reads to float, defaulting to 0.0 on missing or non-numeric input. This keeps the shadow comparison defensive against future waterfall result shape changes.
fix_commit_summary: Fixed the build_canonical_depreciation_wiring call signature (project=... -> project_name=..., capex_items=..., horizon_years=..., cod_period=2, period_frequency='semiannual'). Added explicit fallback to [0.0] * horizon when the canonical engine returns None. The 21 new D3 tests now confirm non-zero canonical outputs for both factory projects.

test_counts.full_57_arc_stack: 1180 passed, 75 skipped, 2 failed (pre-existing 57A-9E test pollution, also fails on main)

stop_after_report_contract.next_phase_start: Final stack validation report (no further phase) — D1+D2+D3 closes the PR #530 safe-next-step arc
stop_after_report_contract.rationale: D3 is the third and final safe step recommended by PR #530. D3 is purely shadow / audit; no runtime enablement, no waterfall change, no formula change. The recommendation is to keep the audit / shadow stack in place and revisit enablement when the wider governance posture changes.
